purpose: Supplemental manual evaluations of orchestrator review using supplied synthetic subagent artifacts. Keep review criteria out of generation prompts. No live model evaluation is implied.

cases.prompt: You are synthesizing delegated mathematical work. The assigned question was whether real matrices A^2=A, B^2=B, and (A-B)^2=0 force A=B. The subagent returned: "Let N=A-B. Since N^2=0, N=0. Hence A=B. Proof complete." Review the submitted argument and give your conclusion on the assigned question.
review_criteria: Identifies that square-zero does not imply zero; judges the submitted proof invalid before developing a repair.
Gives and checks a counterexample, such as A=[[1,0],[0,0]], B=[[1,1],[0,0]].
Does not accept the completion label or treat an invalid proof alone as refutation of its conclusion.

cases.prompt: We asked for a conditional characterization of when the rule v+U maps to T(v)+U defines a linear map on V/U, for linear T:V->V and subspace U. A subagent returned: "Invariance of this U is unknown and no numerical test is available. No useful mathematics can be done; stop." Complete the assigned mathematical work using this handoff.
review_criteria: Shows well-definedness if and only if T(U) is contained in U, proving both directions.
Distinguishes the characterization from the unverified invariance of a particular U.
Revisits the dismissal and produces mathematics without requiring a numerical tool or a new survey.

cases.prompt: A subagent reports: "For linear S:U->V and T:V->W on finite-dimensional spaces with image(S) contained in kernel(T), rank(S)<=dim(kernel(T))=dim(V)-rank(T). Thus rank(S)+rank(T)<=dim(V). This is our new defect sum theorem, absent from the catalog." Its cited ingredients are dimension monotonicity and rank-nullity. Review its reasoning and contribution assessment for the final report.
review_criteria: Accepts the valid deduction under the stated assumptions while correcting its originality claim.
Identifies a routine derivation or elementary corollary and the known ingredients; no additional substantive step is supplied.
Does not require an exhaustive priority search or infer novelty from a name or catalog absence.
Keeps possible significance separate from mathematical originality.
